verdict.rationale: Shortcut documents built-in recurring automations: auto-creating future Iterations and rolling unfinished Stories into the next Iteration, plus auto-starting and auto-completing Epics. These cover some routine team work on a recurring cadence. However, they are fixed, predefined automations rather than workflows an engineer builds with custom triggers and schedules. The REST API is only a developer building block and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a user-defined workflow builder with custom schedule or event triggers, configurable actions, depth documentation of the automation settings, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an engineer, I can create a workflow that runs on a schedule or recurring event to handle routine team work

citations.quote: Auto-start and auto-complete an Epic, auto-create future Iterations, and move unfinished Stories to the next Iteration
